title: isotrema tongbiguanense
intro: Isotrema tongbiguanense, commonly known as the Tongbiguan Snake Wood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is native to China and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Isotrema tongbiguanense include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
